# knowledge-base

> Centralized, high-signal engineering knowledge hub optimized for AI coding agents and RAG systems. Always read this index first, select only the matching entry based on the trigger conditions below, and strictly obey all `MUST` / `NEVER` guardrails inside the target document.

## Agent Retrieval Rules

- Read only entries whose triggers match the current engineering task.
- Treat `Production Architecture` and `Agent Guardrails` sections as hard architectural constraints.
- Do not mix prototype baseline patterns with production blueprints.
- When implementing Web Liquid Glass UI end-to-end, read **both** the Cross-Platform Design System entry (for UI hierarchy, tokens, and component rules) and the WebGPU Liquid Glass entry (for WGSL shader and overlay pipeline invariants).

## Knowledge Index

### AI Agents & Media Workflows

- [Autonomous AI Video Editing Architecture with Claude/Antigravity, Remotion, FFmpeg & Whisper](knowledge/ai-agents-workflows/ai-video-editor-remotion-pipeline.md): Use when building or executing AI-driven video editing pipelines (`raw/`, `references/`, `done/`, `style.md`, `edl.json`) using Claude Code or Antigravity with **Remotion**, **FFmpeg** (`npx remotion ffmpeg`, adaptive 2-pass `loudnorm` + `silencedetect`), **Faster-Whisper** / `@remotion/whisper-webgpu` word-level captions, **yt-dlp** reference ingestion, **HyperFrames** / `<HtmlInCanvas>`, and automatic retake deduplication.

### Design Systems & Cross-Platform UI

- [Cross-Platform iOS Liquid Glass Design System & Architecture (Android & Web)](knowledge/design-systems/ios-liquid-glass-cross-platform.md): Use when designing or implementing iOS 26/27-style Liquid Glass UI on **Android Mobile** (Expo / React Native, Skia, AGSL, `RenderEffect`) or **Web** (React / Next.js / Tailwind CSS), including floating tab bars, navbars, morphing dropdowns, HUD overlays, concentric corner radii, card legibility rules, and 3-tier hardware degradation.

### Graphics & Shaders

- [Production WebGPU Liquid Glass Architecture](knowledge/graphics-shaders/webgpu-liquid-glass.md): Use when building, auditing, or optimizing low-level WebGPU/WGSL shaders for Apple-style Liquid Glass, real-time SDF gradient refraction, liquid element merging (`smin`), Dual-Kawase blur compute shaders, DOM-to-GPU backdrop pipelines, or WebGL2/CSS+SVG fallbacks.

## Templates & Standards

- [KB Entry Template](_templates/kb-entry-template.md): Use when authoring or refactoring a new knowledge base document in this repository.
